Ravaged Star Campaign updates: https://gamefound.com/en/projects/miniwargaming/ravaged-star-tabletop-miniature-wargame/updates

Dave explains MiniWarGaming. He walks through the business's 20-year timeline and its crowdfunding campaign history.  He explains why they are downsizing and addresses concerns about their latest campaign: Ravaged Star, the miniature tabletop wargame. He also reveals something near the end of the video that almost nobody expects could be possible right now. Could it be the end for MiniWarGaming? Watch the video to find out. 

#miniwargaming #ravagedstar
title: Dave Sets the Record Straight
